subject.title: feat(gateway): present system-agent setup QR codes

question: Should OpenClaw standardize this QR PNG acknowledgement shape as the public system-agent Gateway contract before channel producers and generated native clients adopt it?
rationale: The patch is deliberately generic and additive, but the choice fixes a reusable wire contract across Gateway clients rather than repairing an already-defined behavior.

options.title: Approve the protocol direction
options.body: Accept the capability-negotiated QR acknowledgement contract as the stable basis for producer and native-client follow-ups.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Keep the feature in review while owners revise the capability or response shape to match the desired long-term client boundary.

options.title: Defer generic protocol work
options.body: Pause this PR until a concrete producer establishes whether a shared QR contract is necessary.

recommendation.title: Approve the protocol direction
recommendation.body: Accept the capability-negotiated QR acknowledgement contract as the stable basis for producer and native-client follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the focused Gateway, wizard, and Control UI proposal and is the clearest available routing contact for the contract discussion.
